image_description: A medium shot of a De Brazza's monkey (a type of guenon) sitting on a wooden post. The monkey has distinctive grey fur, black limbs, a white chest beard, and a bare face with a prominent orange crescent on the forehead and a blueish nose. It is looking directly at the camera. The background is a soft-focus natural environment.
